§6Euphemium Armor§f

§aFull damage immunity with zero power requirements. The lazy man's endgame armor.§f

Euphemium Armor grants complete resistance to all damage types, including radiation, and gives permanent saturation so you never eat again. It requires no power source to function.

§6Crafting§f: Each piece needs euphemium compound plates (forged in the Plasma Forge from euphemium ingots, astatine powder, bismuth powder, volcanic gem, and osmiridium ingots). The full set uses §e24§f compound plates total. The chestplate also requires a §bBroken Pocket Watch§f, which needs yharonite billets from the DFC.

§6Set bonuses§f: Full set gives saturation, regeneration, resistance, and fire resistance. It blocks all incoming damage including armor-piercing attacks.

§cWARNING:§f You need osmiridium (from Gerald's crater) and yharonite (from the DFC's tungsten crate) to craft this. It's accessible but not cheap.

§ePS:§f If you don't need digamma resistance specifically, this armor is the most practical choice. No power management, no charge anxiety.
